abilities.name: Slam Doors

traits.name: Arcane
traits.text:
This magic comes from the arcane tradition, which is built on logic and rationality. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to arcane magic.

traits.name: Evocation
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the evocation school of magic, typically involving energy and elemental forces.

abilities.trigger: A second creature crosses a magical sensor at the midpoint of the hall.

attacks.name: Ranged
attacks.note: can target any creature in area A8

hazard.description: Five globes shoot bolts of force up and down the hall when a second creature reaches its midpoint.
hazard.disable: Thievery DC 48 (master) to deactivate the trap entirely before it triggers, Thievery DC 45 (expert) to deactivate one of the glimmering orbs after the trap rolls initiative, or *dispel magic* (9th level; counteract DC 41) to deactivate the trap entirely.
hazard.name: Orb Blast Trap
hazard.reset: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no creatures to target and resets automatically after 1 minute.
hazard.routine: (5 actions) Five energized orbs each take one action to make a force bolt attack against a different target in the hallway (a single target cannot be fired at more than once per round by the trap). The trap doesn't take multiple attack penalties. Each orb that is disabled or destroyed reduces the trap's actions by 1.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to realize that the glimmering orbs signal a dangerous trap.

hazard.text: The doors at either end of the hall slam shut and lock in place while the trap is active (the doors open automatically if the trap is disabled or destroyed). The doors (Hardness 14, HP 56 [28 BT]) can be Forced Open with a DC 40 Athletics check, or via a DC 35 Thievery check to Pick the Lock. The trap rolls initiative.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
